pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇissanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhoginiyo 'ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇissantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:1.14.1: yā pana bhikkhunī tiracchānavijjaṃ pariyāpuṇeyya, pācittiyan ti. ||1||
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc49:2.1.8: padena pariyāpuṇāti, pade pade āpatti pācittiyassa.
